mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rent_number), 0) FROM cage_booking_room_aup WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(animal_cage_number, 0) FROM cage_booking_room WHERE room_id = #{roomId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.animal_cage_id) FROM cage_cell_detail d JOIN cage_cell_index ci ON ci.animal_cage_id = d.animal_cage_id JOIN cage_shelf_index si ON si.id = ci.shelf_index_id WHERE si.room_id = #{roomId} AND d.aup_number IS NOT NULL
